public.how.title: Gila ñalngu aawgol haa darnde
public.how.lead: Darnde ndee naatnatee ko e junngo, tee hesɗitataa sey so waylitaama. Ɗoo, nde limtatee e weeyo ɓennuɗo, tee kala baylugol moofta daliilu mum.
public.step.1.title: Mooftu ko demoowo anndi
public.step.1.body: Gese, taƴe gese, aawdi e balɗe aawgol mooftete e Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Ƴettu weeyo ɓennuɗo
public.step.2.body: Nguleeki ñalnde kala e nokku taƴre gese ndee ƴettete e mooftol Open-Meteo, gila aawgol haa hannde.
public.step.3.title: Renndin balɗe nguleeki
public.step.3.body: Balɗe nguleeki puɗol (GDD) renndintee e hiisa aawdi. So limgal ngal ɓurii keerol, yuɓɓinoowo oo yahrina hitaande ndee to darnde rewnde, o moofta daliilu mum.
public.models.title: Hiisaaji aawdi kuutorteeɗi
public.models.lead: Balɗe nguleeki coklaaɗe ngam aawdi ɓennda e nguleeki. Teelte ɗee binndaama junngo, tee ngalaa iwdi humpito tawo.
public.live.title: Ngonka e gese hollirɗe Swartland
public.live.lead: Ɗaɓɓe iwɗe e iwdiiji peñcu, hesɗitinte kala hojom 30.

public.honesty.1.title: Golloowo oo naatnata coñal
public.honesty.1.body: So gollotooɗo winndaani gabbe keɓaaɗe, app oo hollata “Winndaaka”.
public.honesty.2.title: Limooje jerondiral ko keɓe goɗɗe
public.honesty.2.body: Limooje diiwaan e leydi fof mooftete e takardaaji mum, wondude e iwdi e unit. Ɗe jerondiraaka e gabbe ngesa.
public.honesty.3.title: Keɓe ñaamooji ko ɗe diiwaan
public.honesty.3.body: Keɓe GBIF ɗe yiyaaɗe kollirtee ko ko yiyaa hakkunde 100 km, wondude e yolnde.
public.honesty.4.title: Keɓe weeyo ko kesɗe
public.honesty.4.body: Tamperatiir keɓete e mooftol Open-Meteo nde ɗaɓɓitaama.
public.open.title: Uddit hitaande demal
public.open.body: Naat e demo ngam yiyde laawol GDD hitaande demal e daliilu ngonɗo caggal daraja mum.

public.about.title: Baɗte
public.about.heading: Baɗte Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis ko app tokkuɗo gese e aawdi e gese goote e Western Cape.
public.about.why.title: Ko waɗi ɗum woodi
public.about.why.body: Darajaaji ngesa kiiɗata, gabbe keɓaaɗe kadi naatniree ko siftoraa. Mecropolis hiisa daraja e weeyo mooftaaɗo. Limre kala iwata e gollotooɗo walla iwdi peñcu innaangu.
public.about.design.title: No ɗum waɗiraa
public.about.design.1.body: Balɗe tamperatiir naatɗe e mawnugol (GDD) ɓeydoto gila ñalngu aawugol, huutoraade mooftol Open-Meteo. Baylugol daraja kala moofta daliilu mum: ñalngu ɗum fuɗɗi, kuuɓal GDD e ko ɗum iwri.
public.about.design.2.body: Daraja caggal ko adii coñal inniraa benndugol mawnugol sabu tamperatiir, sabu coñal winndaaka.
public.about.design.4.body: Ɗe mooftete e takardaaji mum, wondude e iwdi, unit e yamiroore huutorgol.
public.about.stack.title: Teknolojiiji
public.about.stack.body: App hello wooto Vite e React 19 dow Cloudflare Pages. Wanngorde janngata keɓe peñcu Sanity bec e GROQ e heɗtorde kesɗitinal. Binndugol e keɓe cokluɗe kelal rewata e Cloudflare Pages Functions, ɗe ƴeewta kukii naatal siynaaɗo. Zod ƴeewta keɓe naatɗe e jaltuɗe, Vitest ƴeewta app oo, Tailwind 4 waɗa mbaydi.
public.about.limits.title: Ko ɗum waawaa tawo
public.about.limits.1: Limooje model aawdi (tamperatiir lesɗo, sahaa tamperatiir haa fuɗugol e benndugol) winndiraa junngo, tee ngalaa iwdi tawo.
public.about.limits.2: Limre jerondiral lupin iwri e HarvestStat tan hakkunde 2000 e 2007, tee doggol aɗaade keɓe yiytaani takarda jerondiral lupin.
public.about.limits.3: Keɓe ñaamooji ko keɓe GBIF ɗe yiyaaɗe ɓadii gese ɗee. Ɗe kollata nokku ɗo fannu taguure winndaa ɓadii gese ɗee.
public.about.limits.4: Demo oo jogii naatal gootal ngal fof huutortoo e paddoowo ɗaɓɓitanɗe e hakkille. Naatal ngal suuɗata kelle dashboard, kono reenaaki keɓe ɗee: yimɓe fof mbaawi janngude ɗe. Kono ɗum reenata binndugol kala.

docs.stages.title: Laawol darajaaji
docs.stages.intro: Hitaande demal ɓennata yeeso e darajaaji jeegom:
docs.stages.guards: Ɓennugol kala jogii sarɗi. Aawaama sokli ñalngu aawugol e aawdi; nana mawni sokli keerol fuɗugol e balɗe tamperatiir; ko adii coñal sokli 90% e keerol benndugol; benndugol mawnugol sabu tamperatiir sokli yottagol keerol benndugol; ƴeewtagol sokli natal weeyo hitaande demal e limre jerondiral tabitinaande. Sarɗi GDD kadi cokli keɓe tamperatiir e ko famɗi 90% e sahaa oo. Ɓennugol ngal ñalngu mum woni yeeso paddete.

docs.seed.body: {0} winndat demal demo ngal, gese mum, aawdi e duuɓi demal e dataset suɓaa ngal, kadi nanndina keɓe diiwaan ngal. Ɗum lomtina demal ngal, gese ɗen e aawdi ndin, wadde huutoro ɗum tan e dataset jeyaaɗo maa.
guide.title: No Mecropolis huutortee
guide.lead: Janngirde raɓɓunde e kelme laaɓɗe. Ɗum hollat ko app oo waɗata, ɓe o waɗanaa e ko kala geɗel mum waɗata.
guide.what.title: Ko Mecropolis woni
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis ko app tokkuɗo gese e aawdi. O limat no aawdi kala ɓadortoo ɓenndugol, tawa o ɓeyda nguleeki keɓiiki gila aawugol. O hollat kadi sahaa, leydi e ñoŋkotooji sara demal maa e nokku gooto.
guide.what.p2: O mahanaa gese Western Cape e Afrik Worgo, kono ɗum waawi huutoreede e demal kala, diiwaan kala e hitaande demal kala.
guide.who.title: Ɓe o waɗanaa
guide.who.p1: O waɗanaa neɗɗo deenoowo gese, hono demoowo, ardiiɗo demal walla coktirɗo balloowo ɓe.
guide.who.p2: A soklaani anndude ordinateer walla ganndal sahaa. So a waawi udditde lowre geese, a waawi huutoraade Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Ko waɗi a huutortoo ɗum
guide.why.1: A waawi yiyde law ko aawdi holi aawaa jooni, holi woni e mawnugol, e holi ɓadtii ɓenndude.
guide.why.2: A soklaani hesɗitinde ngesa kala junngo, sabu app oo ɓeydina aawdi ndin yeeso so sahaa hollii ko sahaa mum yontii.
guide.why.3: O reentinat maa e nguleeki e ɓuuɓol ɓurɗe e balɗe garooje, e ñoŋkotooji jiyanooɗi sara demal maa.
guide.why.4: Kala ko winndaa baɗte ngesa, hono piɗugol, ñoŋkotoowo njiy-ɗaa walla ciimtol, heddoto e nokku gooto wondude e ñalngu mum, ngam a waawa yiytude ɗum caggal.
guide.why.5: Limre kala hollat ɗo nde iwri, ngam a annda ko hoolaade.
guide.heat.title: No app oo anndirta ɗo aawdi yahi
guide.heat.p1: Aawdi mawnat law so nguleeki woodi, kadi leeltat so ɓuuɓol woodi. Mecropolis limat nguleeki ndii ñalngu kala e heat units, ɗi gannduɓe noddata growing degree days walla GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Ñalngu kala, o ƴettat hakkunde tamperatiir ɓurɗo toowde e ɓurɗo lesɗude, o ittana tamperatiir ɗo aawdi ndin dartata mawnude. Ko heddii woni heat units ñalngu nguu. Ñalngu ɓuuɓɗo ɓeydataa hay huunde.
guide.heat.p3: Aawdi kala sokli limre heat units keeriiɗe hade mum ɓenndude. So limre gila aawugol ɓadtii limre ndee, aawdi ndin yahat e darnde rewnde.
guide.heat.p4: Tamperatiir ɗin iwata e Open-Meteo, carwol sahaa dokkal limotoongol sahaa nokku kala e aduna.
guide.stages.title: Darɗe jeegom
guide.stages.intro: Aawdi kala e ngesa kala yahat e darɗe ɗee, e deggondiral ngol.
guide.stages.planning: Hitaande demal ndee siryaama, kono aawdi ndin aawaaka tawo.
guide.stages.growing: Aawdi ndin woni e ɓeydude heat units.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Aawdi ndin heɓii ko ɓuri heewde e nguleeki ndi sokli, wadde ko sahaa siryaade coñal.
guide.stages.harvested: Aawdi ndin heɓii nguleeki fof ndi sokli, wadde nde foti ɓenndude. Ko aan tan waawi wiide so nde coñama goonga, wadde app oo noddat ɗum ɓenndugol nguleeki.
guide.stages.review: Hitaande demal ndee gasii, a waawi ƴeewtaade no nde yahiri.
guide.stages.p2: App oo ƴeewtat aawdi kala jemma kala, e kala nde neɗɗo ɓeydi ko o yiyii walla golle waɗaaɗe. A waawi kadi ñoƴƴude Reconcile now e hitaande demal ngam ƴeewtaade ɗoon e ɗoon.
guide.start.title: Fuɗɗaade
guide.start.1: Uddit hello jaɓɓorgo. A waawi yiyde kartal sahaa, leydi, ñoŋkotooji e keɓe e demal demo ngal tawa a seŋaaki.
guide.start.2: Ñoƴƴu Sign in dow, kuutoro humpito konte demo ɗe kokkaa.
guide.start.3: Suɓo demal. Ɗum udditat alluwal demal ngal.
guide.start.4: Ñoƴƴu hitaande demal ngam yiyde kala huunde baɗte aawdi ndin e ngesa ngaan.
guide.start.5: Huutoro suɓirgal ɗemngal dow hello kala ngam waylude ɗemngal. App oo siftortoo suɓo maa nde arataa.
guide.home.title: Hello jaɓɓorgo
guide.home.p1: Hello jaɓɓorgo hollat kartal diiwaan ngal, no nguleeki leydi ndin heɓi e hitaande demal ndee. Ɗum hollat kadi sahaa jooni e balɗe garooje, leydi demal demo ngal, ñoŋkotooji jiyanooɗi sara ɗoon e keɓe hakkunde diiwaan ngal. A soklaani seŋaade ngam yiyde ɗum.
guide.dashboard.title: Alluwal demal
guide.dashboard.intro: Alluwal ngal hollat demal gootal. Ɗee ngoni geɗe mum, gila dow hello haa les. Suɓirgal demal dow ngal wallat maa yahde e demal goɗngal.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Tonngol demal
guide.dashboard.summary: No gese e ha demal ngal jogii, no hitaande demal woni e yahde, e no aawdi ɓenndii.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Ko sokli ƴeewteede
guide.dashboard.alerts: Reentinooje raɓɓuɗe, hono ɓuuɓol walla nguleeki e haalugol sahaa, aawdi ɓenndundi, hitaande demal fuɗɗaaki e sahaa, walla ñoŋkotooji jiyanooɗi sara ngesa. Reentinoore kala hollat ko waɗi nde.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Ngonka demal
guide.dashboard.conditions: Sahaa hannde, haalugol sahaa, leydi e ñoŋkotooji sara demal ngal.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Yahdu hitaande demal
guide.dashboard.progress: Kartal aawdi kala hollata no nguleeki mum ɓeydori. A waawi yerondirde gese ɗen, kadi aawta doggol ngol e fiilde tabel (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Gese
guide.dashboard.fields: Gese demal ngal fof, wondude e mawɗe mum, leydi mum e aawdi mum.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Yiylo winndanɗe
guide.dashboard.search: Winndu ko njiɗ-ɗaa e kelme laaɓɗe, hono aphids e alkama. Ɗum yiylat ko yiyaa e golle waɗaaɗe ɗe maanaa gooto, hay so kelme ɗen ceerti.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Wasiyaaji
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Golle wasiyaaɗe e ngesa, hono piɗugol walla nawoore. A waawi jaɓde walla salde kala gootel, kadi maantude ɗum gasii so golle ɗen timmii.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Ko waɗaa ko ɓuri hesɗude
guide.dashboard.activity: Doggol sahaa nde aawdi kala yahdi e darnde hesere.
guide.season.title: Hello hitaande demal
guide.season.intro: Hitaande demal ko aawdi gooti e ngesa gooto e hitaande wootere. Hello mum jogii kala ko ɗum foti.
guide.season.top.label: Dow hello
guide.season.top: Aawdi ndin, ngesa ngaan, ñalngu aawugol, coñal tijjaaɗo e keɓe caggal nde naatnu-ɗaa ɗe.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Darɗe aawdi
guide.season.pipeline: Darɗe jeegom, darnde jooni maantinaama. Ñoƴƴu Reconcile now ngam ƴeewtaade ɗoon e ɗoon so aawdi ndin foti yahde yeeso.
guide.season.readiness.label: Ko siryii ngam yahde yeeso
guide.season.readiness: Doggol ko app oo sokli hade mum ɓeydinde aawdi ndin yeeso, hono ñalngu aawugol e humpito sahaa keewɗo. Geɗel kala wi'at Pass, Warning walla Blocked; so ɗum Blocked, ɗum hollat ko ŋakki.
guide.season.evidence.label: Seedeeji
guide.season.evidence: Winndanɗe ɗe app oo huutori e cuɓe mum, ngam a waawa ƴeewtaade ɗe.
guide.season.propose.label: Wasiya golle
guide.season.propose: Wasiya golle e ngesa ngaan, wondude e seedeeji hitaande demal ndee. Ɗum heddoto e ciimtol haa neɗɗo jaɓa ɗum e alluwal ngal.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Jaaynirgal heat units ɓeydooɗi gila aawugol, wondude e diidol limre fof nde aawdi ndin sokli.
guide.season.whatIf.label: So tawii?
guide.season.whatIf: Ƴeewndo ñalngu aawugol ɓurɗo arde walla leelde, walla hitaande ɓurnde wulude walla ɓuuɓude, ngam yiyde no heat units wayrata. Hay huunde danndetaake.
guide.season.summary.label: Tonngol hitaande demal
guide.season.summary: Tonngol raɓɓungol winndanɗe hitaande demal, AI winndi ɗum. Huutoro ɗum ngam wallaade maa, kono ƴeewto winndanɗe ɗen so huunde waynii.
guide.season.notes.label: Ciimtol hitaande demal
guide.season.notes: Ciimtol hitaande demal wondude e ñalɗe. A waawi ɓeydude, waylude e momtude ɗum, kadi artirde yamre ɓurnde hiiɗude.
guide.season.files.label: Foto ngesa e jaŋtol ƴeewtagol leydi
guide.season.files: Yollu foto ngesa e PDF ƴeewtagol leydi iwɗo e laboratuwaar.
guide.season.log.label: Deftere ngesa
guide.season.log: Ko njiy-ɗaa e ngesa e ko mbaɗ-ɗaa e mum, hono piɗugol wondude e innde kaɓirgol e ɓetirgol mum.
guide.season.history.label: Aslol bayle
guide.season.history: Bayle danndaaɗe fof e hitaande demal ndee, wondude e ñalɗe mum.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Keɓe diiwaan ngam yerondirde
guide.season.benchmark: Keɓe hakkunde diiwaan ngal iwɗe e limlimtooje peñcu. Ɗe ngoni ngam yerondirde tan, wonaa keɓe ngesa maa.
guide.season.pests.label: Jiyte ñoŋkotooji e diiwaan
guide.season.pests: Ñoŋkotooji jaŋtaaɗi sara ngesa e GBIF, deftere peñcu jiyte. Ñoƴƴu Fetch sightings ngam heɓde ɗe ɓuri hesɗude.
guide.sources.title: Ɗo limlimtooje ɗen iwri
guide.sources.weather: Humpito sahaa iwata e Open-Meteo, ngam hannde, balɗe garooje e balɗe yawtuɗe.
guide.sources.soil: Humpito leydi iwata e SoilGrids, kartal leydi aduna.
guide.sources.pests: Jiyte ñoŋkotooji iwata e GBIF, deftere peñcu jiyte.
guide.sources.yields: Keɓe diiwaan iwata e USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa e World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Ko heddii fof, hono ciimtol, golle waɗaaɗe e keɓe maa, ko aan walla yimɓe maa naatni.
guide.limits.title: Ko ɗum waawataa waɗde
guide.limits.model: Heat units ɗi aawdi kala sokli ko miijooji amen, ɗi ƴeewtaaka tawo e ngesa. Huutoro ɗi hono ɗowirde, kono hoolo ko njiy-ɗaa e ngesa maa.
guide.limits.maturity: Ɓenndugol e nguleeki ko sahaa wi'i aawdi ndin ɓenndii. Ko aan tan anndi si ɓenndii e goonga.
guide.limits.translation: AI winndii firooji ɗii. Ɗi foti weeɓde faamde, kono neɗɗo mo Fula woni ɗemngal mum ƴeewtaaki ɗemɗe ɗen fof.
